newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTANI STOCKS SEESAW, CLOSE UP ON BLUE CHIPS.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTANI STOCKS SEESAW, CLOSE UP ON BLUE CHIPS.

text.p: Pakistani stocks seesawed and closed up on Thursday on buying of blue chips by overseas investors, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.

The Karachi 100-index closed 11.12 points, or 0.56 percent, up at 2,011.25 after falling to 1,972.09 in early trading. Losers led gainers 152 to 64 at the close at 14.00 p.m. (0900 GMT). Scrips are likely to post fresh gains in computerised trading in the evening, a dealer said.
Adamjee Insurance rose three rupees to 125, Pakistan Telecommunication Co Ltd 0.80 to 43.25 and Shell Pakistan two to 290. - Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
